RNA-seq of HVOX human vocal fold fibroblats treated or untreated with TGF-beta1 and a YAP/TAZ inhibitor, K-975.

SMAD2/3 and YAP/TAZ are activated by TGF-beta signaling in human vocal fold fibroblasts. This study provides transcriptomic data regarding altered gene expression following TGF-beta treatment and YAP/TAZ inhibition.
